notes.title: Steam Deck + Linux (Proton 9.0+)
notes.notes: [p]We have removed the native Linux build of Corgi Cove in favor of using Proton's compatibility layer to run the Windows build. This currently seems more stable and easier to maintain.[/p][p][/p][p]To run Corgi Cove on your Steam Deck or Linux device, inside the game's Steam settings, please force compatibility using Proton 9.0-4 or newer.[/p][p][/p][p]The game should look and play great, as it did previously, with full controller support.[/p][p]Please let us know if you experience any issues.[/p][p][/p][p]-Recall Software Team[/p]

notes.title: Cloud Saves + QoL Tweaks
notes.notes:
Cloud Saves are now supported!

There has also been QoL tweaks, as well as optimizations for low spec devices.
Corgi Cove should now perform better than ever if you are running a potato. 🥔

Have fun, all! 
*WOOF*

-Stephen (Recall Software)

notes.title: Achievements Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Corgi Cove v1.0.2[/h3]

Achievements have made their way into Corgi Cove!
Please be aware that only some achievements are retroactive with existing save files.

On a side note, Cloud Saves could make a return in the near future. 💾

Happy Puzzling.
-Stephen

🐶🐶🐶

notes.title: Bug Fix and QoL Update!
notes.notes:
Corgi Cove v1.0.1 is now live!

Along with various bug fixes and quality of life improvements, this update also improves support for monitors with non-16:9 ratios!

For any of you looking for achievements, we are aiming to have them added in a future update.

Happy puzzling!

🐶🐶🐶

notes.title: Cloud Saving Removed
notes.notes:
Due to trouble with Cloud Saves, we have decided to remove the feature for now, as it appears that player progress has not been getting saved for some users, which isn't good at all! 

Sadly, this update will clear all save data for all users up to this point. I (Stephen) sincerely apologize for this oversight. If you would like to have your saved progress restored manually, you can contact us at HelloRecallSoftware@gmail.com for support.

We will look into adding Cloud Saves back, once we can ensure it is working as intended.

-Stephen Loney
